key_moments.title: Experts have warned that irregular and overuse of steroids can cause severe infections like pneumonia and mucormycosis
Most of the COVID-19 patients die due to the hyper-immune response to the virus
Steroids are used to treat COVID-19 patients who develop a severe hyper-immune response
But taking steroids in the early stage of COVID-19 can affect the efficiency of the immune system
This can lead to further replication of the virus and severe viral pneumonia
As per ICMR guidelines, steroids should be given for only 5-10 days
Long term use of steroids can cause a rise in blood glucose levels, which may trigger bacterial or fungal infections
